title.en: Snap or say, then one tap: a photo, a sentence, Publish
title.af: Kiek of sê, dan een tik: 'n foto, 'n sin, Publiseer
title.zu: Thwebula noma usho, bese kuthephwa kanye: isithombe, umusho, Shicilela
title.xh: Fota okanye uthethe, emva koko ucofe kanye: ifoto, isivakalisi, Papasha
title.nso: Tšea seswantšho goba o bolele, gomme o kgotle gatee: seswantšho, lefoko, Phatlalatša

chapters.nso: E tšee seswantšho goba o e bolele

chapters.af: As iets nie duidelik was nie
chapters.nso: Ge e le gore se sengwe se be se sa kwagale

en: Tap [[Snap it]] or [[Say it]] on Quick's first screen
Under the two usual buttons. Snap is for a thing you can photograph; Say is for work you do.
af: Tik [[Snap it]] of [[Say it]] op Quick se eerste skerm
Onder die twee gewone knoppies. Snap is vir 'n ding wat jy kan afneem; Say is vir werk wat jy doen.
zu: Thepha [[Snap it]] noma [[Say it]] esikrinini sokuqala se-Quick
Ngaphansi kwezinkinobho ezimbili ezijwayelekile. U-Snap owento ongayithwebula; u-Say owomsebenzi owenzayo.
xh: Cofa [[Snap it]] okanye [[Say it]] kwisikrini sokuqala se-Quick
Ngaphantsi kwamaqhosha amabini aqhelekileyo. U-Snap ngowento onokuyifota; u-Say ngowomsebenzi owenzayo.
nso: Kgotla [[Snap it]] goba [[Say it]] sekirining sa mathomo sa Quick
Ka tlase ga dikonope tše pedi tša ka mehla. Snap ke ya selo seo o ka se tšeago seswantšho; Say ke ya mošomo wo o o dirago.

en: Tap [[Take photo]] or [[Use last photo]]. From your gallery you can also share a picture straight to Quick. The example photo is never published — your photo is the advert's photo.
af: Tik [[Take photo]] of [[Use last photo]]. Vanuit jou galery kan jy ook 'n prent direk na Quick deel. Die voorbeeldfoto word nooit gepubliseer nie — jou foto is die advertensie se foto.
zu: Thepha [[Take photo]] noma [[Use last photo]]. Ungaphinde wabelane ngesithombe ngqo ku-Quick usuka kugalari yakho. Isithombe sesibonelo asishicilelwa — isithombe sakho yisithombe sesikhangiso.
xh: Cofa [[Take photo]] okanye [[Use last photo]]. Ungakwazi nokwabelana ngomfanekiso ngqo ku-Quick usuka kwigalari yakho. Ifoto yomzekelo ayipapashwa — ifoto yakho yifoto yesibhengezo.
nso: Kgotla [[Take photo]] goba [[Use last photo]]. Go tšwa galering ya gago o ka abelana ka seswantšho thwii go Quick. Seswantšho sa mohlala ga se phatlalatšwe — seswantšho sa gago ke seswantšho sa papatšo.

en: Tap the microphone and say it, or type it: “Home cleaner, Mamelodi, Tuesdays and Thursdays, R350 a day.” The price, the area and the days help. Then tap [[Make my advert]].
af: Tik die mikrofoon en sê dit, of tik dit in: “Home cleaner, Mamelodi, Tuesdays and Thursdays, R350 a day.” Die prys, die area en die dae help. Tik dan [[Make my advert]].
zu: Thepha imakrofoni bese uyasho, noma ukuthayiphe: “Home cleaner, Mamelodi, Tuesdays and Thursdays, R350 a day.” Intengo, indawo nezinsuku kuyasiza. Bese uthepha [[Make my advert]].
xh: Cofa imakrofoni uze uyithethe, okanye uyichwetheze: “Home cleaner, Mamelodi, Tuesdays and Thursdays, R350 a day.” Ixabiso, indawo neentsuku ziyanceda. Emva koko cofa [[Make my advert]].
nso: Goba o bolele lefoko le tee
Kgotla maekrofouno gomme o e bolele, goba o e thaepe: “Home cleaner, Mamelodi, Tuesdays and Thursdays, R350 a day.” Theko, lefelo le matšatši di a thuša. Gomme o kgotle [[Make my advert]].

en: The kind, the title, the words, the area from your phone and the price are filled in. Change anything by tapping it.
af: Die soort, die titel, die woorde, die area vanaf jou foon en die prys is ingevul. Verander enigiets deur daarop te tik.
zu: Uhlobo, isihloko, amazwi, indawo evela efonini yakho nentengo kugcwalisiwe. Shintsha noma yini ngokuyithepha.
xh: Uhlobo, isihloko, amazwi, indawo evela kwifowuni yakho nexabiso zigcwalisiwe. Tshintsha nantoni na ngokuyicofa.
nso: Mohuta, sehlogo, mantšu, lefelo go tšwa founung ya gago le theko di tladitšwe. Fetola se sengwe le se sengwe ka go se kgotla.

en: One tap: [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]

Your e-mail, then the button. The tap is your signature on the Terms. Your photo goes through the same quick anonymity check as every photo; if it is held, the advert still goes live and the photo joins it once checked.
af: Een tik: [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]

Jou e-pos, dan die knoppie. Die tik is jou handtekening op die Terme. Jou foto gaan deur dieselfde vinnige anonimiteitskontrole as elke foto; as dit teruggehou word, gaan die advertensie steeds lewendig en die foto sluit later aan.
zu: Ukuthepha kanye: [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]

I-imeyili yakho, bese kuba inkinobho. Ukuthepha kuyisiginesha yakho eMigomweni. Isithombe sakho sidlula kuhlolo olufanayo olusheshayo lokungaziwa njengazo zonke izithombe; uma sibanjiwe, isikhangiso siyaphuma futhi isithombe siyahlangana naso uma sesihloliwe.
xh: Ukucofa kanye: [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]

I-imeyile yakho, emva koko iqhosha. Ukucofa kukutyikitya kwakho kwiMigaqo. Ifoto yakho idlula kolo hlolo lukhawulezayo lokungaziwa njengayo yonke ifoto; ukuba ibanjiwe, isibhengezo siyaphuma kwaye ifoto iyangena xa sele ihloliwe.
nso: Go kgotla gatee: [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]

Imeile ya gago, gomme konope. Go kgotla ke mosaeno wa gago Mabakeng. Seswantšho sa gago se feta tlhahlobong ye e swanago ya go akgofa ya go se tsebje bjalo ka seswantšho se sengwe le se sengwe; ge se swerwe, papatšo e sa dutše e tšwa gomme seswantšho se a tsenela ge se šetše se hlahlobilwe.

en: If the photo or your words did not say something — the make of the car, the days you work — Quick asks just that question, with one line saying why. Nothing is guessed on your behalf.
af: As die foto of jou woorde iets nie gesê het nie — die kar se fabrikaat, die dae wat jy werk — vra Quick net daardie vraag, met een reël wat sê hoekom. Niks word namens jou geraai nie.
zu: Uma isithombe noma amazwi akho kungashongo okuthile — uhlobo lwemoto, izinsuku osebenza ngazo — i-Quick ibuza lowo mbuzo kuphela, ngomugqa owodwa othi kungani. Akukho okuqagelwa egameni lakho.
xh: Ukuba ifoto okanye amazwi akho awazange athethe into ethile — uhlobo lwemoto, iintsuku osebenza ngazo — i-Quick ibuza loo mbuzo kuphela, ngomgca omnye othi kutheni. Akukho nto iqikelelwayo egameni lakho.
nso: Potšišo yeo o sa e arabago

Ge seswantšho goba mantšu a gago a sa bolela se sengwe — mohuta wa koloi, matšatši ao o šomago ka ona — Quick e botšiša fela potšišo yeo, ka mothaladi o tee wo o bolelago gore ke ka lebaka la eng. Ga go selo se se akanyetšwago legatong la gago.
